name: ref-tools
description: Claude Code plugins for Ref — documentation search, refs, and UI sweep.

plugins.name: ref-context
plugins.description: Documentation search over public and private docs via the Ref Context MCP server.

plugins.name: ref-plan
plugins.description: Read and write refs through OAuth, with optional personal memory alongside native memory in Claude Code.

plugins.name: ref-skills
plugins.description: Agent skills for Ref. Includes ui-sweep: sweep a web app feature's UI end to end — sandbox the app, catalog every screen into a Ref, report bugs with fix proposals, leave a reusable .ui-sweep/ scaffold; with --fix, ship draft PRs and work the review loop.
